scoring.range: Each dimension is an integer from 0 to 5. Score is positive sum minus negative sum.

opportunities.observed_pain: Provider cost is discussed, but cost per accepted repository decision has not been measured on a fixed corpus.
opportunities.hypothesis: A Jev gate cuts downstream expensive-provider input by at least 50% with unchanged acceptance criteria and zero false supported decisions.
opportunities.baseline: Run the same fixed downstream model on all 12 labeled cases.
opportunities.success_metric: At least 50% lower downstream input cost per accepted result, zero false supports, and no material calibration regression.
opportunities.falsifier: Any false support, lower acceptance quality, or human-review and retry cost that erases the saving.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: Deterministic rules or repository search before any model call.
opportunities.authority: Human approves live spend and any integration; model output never grants effects.
opportunities.next_gate: Run the fixed downstream A/B the hypothesis actually states, gated by Jev against ungated, on the same 12 cases. The 13-call calibration does not test it.
opportunities.result: Live 13 calls at jev-1.13.0, 2026-09-23: batching the 12 questions over one shared state used 2487 input tokens against 14939 for the same 12 questions asked one at a time, 83.4% less, with the identical choice on all 12 cases, zero false supports and zero retries (accuracy 0.9167 both ways, Brier 0.1657 against 0.1645; 453 ms against 4451 ms). This measures amortizing shared state, not the hypothesis: no downstream model was called, so the 50% downstream saving is still unmeasured. Token counts are the provider's reported usage, not billed cost, which stays unknown; the $0.0021 ceiling is a local byte proxy only.

opportunities.observed_pain: Course prose, runnable examples, three locale mirrors and journals can drift because their relationship is mostly checked manually.
opportunities.hypothesis: A machine-readable opportunity registry plus executable journal checks reduces drift and unsupported claims without making authoring slower.
opportunities.baseline: Current manual review of prose, code, journal evidence and EN/FR/ES mirrors.
opportunities.success_metric: Zero matrix drift, every measured claim linked to an artifact, locale file parity, and authoring lead time no worse than baseline.
opportunities.falsifier: Generated structure becomes busywork, misses semantic translation drift, or increases lead time without finding defects.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: A small publication checklist enforced in PR review.
opportunities.authority: Course author records evidence; reviewer accepts or rejects publication claims.
opportunities.next_gate: Use this course to validate its own registry, generated matrices and locale parity in CI.
opportunities.result: Registry, renderer and invariant tests implemented as the first tracer bullet.

opportunities.technique: Jev advisory evidence plus Petri authority boundary
opportunities.observed_pain: A high-confidence text classification can be mistaken for an implementation grant, while concurrent lifecycle safety is hard to infer from one execution trace.
opportunities.hypothesis: A Petri oracle can expose a reachable unauthorized effect when Jev advisory support is treated as authority, and prove that the bounded guarded model blocks it without independent evidence and an explicit grant.
opportunities.baseline: Confidence-only threshold 0.95 on the pinned synthetic Jev case, with an unsafe advisory-to-effect net.
opportunities.success_metric: Reproducible unsafe witness; complete guarded reachability with no effect unless both independent proof and grant tokens are present; no provider call or production effect.
opportunities.falsifier: Any guarded reachable effect without both tokens, incomplete reachability claimed as proof, or model assumptions that do not match a pinned repository seam.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: A deterministic authority check and one focused replay test may suffice without a Petri net or Jev.
opportunities.authority: Repository owner reviews the exact seam and replay; Jev never grants effects and this local model grants no production authority.
opportunities.next_gate: Pin one Gaia or IX transition at an exact revision, map its real guards to places, replay a counterexample against the public seam, and obtain independent review before incubation.
opportunities.result: Offline synthetic wrong support at 0.98: guarded model blocks effect without independently verified evidence and implementation authority; 3/3 focused Petri tests and fixture parity test pass. No repository integration or live Jev result.

opportunities.observed_pain: Infrastructure coupling is suspected at some orchestration boundaries, but no current cross-repository inventory is attached.
opportunities.hypothesis: One evidence-backed port around a frequently changed external dependency reduces test setup and change surface.
opportunities.baseline: Measure callers, dependency fan-in, test setup and files changed for one real boundary before refactoring.
opportunities.success_metric: Smaller change surface and simpler deterministic tests on the selected seam, with no extra pass-through abstraction.
opportunities.falsifier: The port only renames an existing interface or increases indirection without reducing coupled changes.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: Keep the current interface and add one focused contract test.
opportunities.authority: Repository maintainer selects the seam after reviewing evidence.
opportunities.next_gate: Choose one exact dependency boundary and capture a before metric; otherwise reject the candidate.

opportunities.technique: RabbitMQ quorum, retry and dead-letter boundary
opportunities.observed_pain: Cross-process reliability is important, but no evidence yet shows RabbitMQ is simpler than the existing artifact and GitHub contracts.
opportunities.hypothesis: A bounded broker tracer improves recoverable delivery for one high-contention path without replacing durable repository artifacts.
opportunities.baseline: Measure loss, duplicate handling and recovery time in the current path.
opportunities.success_metric: Demonstrably better recovery with idempotent consumers and lower operational cost than the current mechanism.
opportunities.falsifier: The broker duplicates existing durable contracts or adds an always-on dependency without a measured reliability gain.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: Keep append-only artifacts and improve reconciliation.
opportunities.authority: Architecture owner approves any infrastructure addition.
opportunities.next_gate: Identify one failure mode that existing artifact reconciliation cannot solve economically.
opportunities.result: Local course examples exist; no repository adoption evidence.

opportunities.technique: Petri net reachability on resource pipelines
opportunities.observed_pain: Concurrency defects in GA live on exception paths the test suite never takes, so they are found in production rather than in CI.
opportunities.hypothesis: Modelling a pipeline that holds a scarce resource as a place/transition net and searching its reachability graph for dead markings finds real defects the existing tests miss, from a read-only reading of the source.
opportunities.baseline: GA's own suite at a826864f3a012cad88e415954bf57eca0ce12aa6: none of the three defects below is covered by a test.
opportunities.success_metric: At least one defect confirmed line by line against the source and accepted by the maintainer.
opportunities.falsifier: The issues are closed as not-a-bug, shown to be already covered by a test, or the firing sequence the net produces turns out not to be reachable in the real code.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: Reading the exception paths by hand, which is what missed them, or a linter for 'acquire outside try', which would catch GaFsiSessionPool but not the two producer/consumer hangs - those need the state space.
opportunities.authority: Read-only analysis at a pinned commit; the model proposes, a maintainer decides. No GA code was read outside the GitHub API and none was modified.
opportunities.next_gate: Maintainer triage of GuitarAlchemist/ga#700, #701 and #702. GA's own todo 047 already asks for the exception-safe release of #700, which is corroboration, not acceptance.
opportunities.result: Three defects found, each confirmed against the source before filing. GaFsiSessionPool.fs: the `with ex` handler releases the gate without returning the session; two exceptions wedge the process-wide pool for good, and the net gave the seven-firing sequence - one caller, no concurrency needed - before the code confirmed it. IndexVoicingsCommand: consumer catch outside the await foreach, bounded channel in FullMode.Wait, CancellationToken.None: total silent deadlock. VoicingGenerator: Complete() outside a finally, one-sided hang that swallows the producer exception. One claim was withdrawn before filing: the early gate release at :144 is not a bug, because the evaluation has already returned at :140.

opportunities.technique: Cross-check TARS grammar rules against Petri nets
opportunities.observed_pain: GA's orchestration is encoded twice, independently: as five weighted rules in the TARS grammar ecosystem (ga.orchestrator_pipeline, ga.routing_fallback_cascade, ga.hook_lifecycle_fsm, ga.domain_skill_fastpath, ga.confidence_evidence_response) and as Petri nets in the petri-nets course. Nobody has compared them.
opportunities.hypothesis: Two independent encodings of the same pipelines disagree somewhere, and every disagreement is a place where one of them is wrong about GA - decidable against the source, as the three defects of petri-net-pipeline-soundness were.
opportunities.baseline: The five ga.* rules as they stand on 2026-09-23: SuccessRate 1.0 on SelectionCount 4, Confidence 0.278. A success rate of 1 on four draws is not evidence of anything, which is itself the first thing to check.
opportunities.success_metric: Every disagreement between the two encodings resolved against the pinned source, and at least one of them corrected as a result.
opportunities.falsifier: The two encodings agree everywhere, or their disagreements cannot be decided against the source because the grammar rules describe intent rather than control flow. Either outcome retires the candidate.
opportunities.simpler_alternative: Read GA's orchestrator once and trust that reading, which is what both encodings already did separately.
opportunities.authority: Read-only on both repositories. No grammar weight may gate a promotion in this registry: an evolved weight is the score-as-authority failure this lab exists to refuse, arrived at by a longer road.
opportunities.next_gate: Read the five ga.* rule definitions, not only their weights, and put ga.hook_lifecycle_fsm next to the chat-turn net, whose place invariant sent = 0 says the streaming path cannot run the hooks - GuitarAlchemist/ga#703.
opportunities.result: Nothing measured yet: the rule weights were read, the rule bodies were not.

opportunities.technique: Jev as an advisory hexavalent annotator
opportunities.observed_pain: Demerzel classifies evidence into six truth values (T/P/U/D/F/C) by hand; the one live Jev error on Demerzel evidence (2026-09-22) read a missing digest as a conflict.
opportunities.hypothesis: Given only Demerzel's own definitions, Jev classifies synthetic governance evidence at >= 75% exact match with at most one false T and at most one absence read as refutation.
opportunities.baseline: Fixed substring cues (keyword baseline): 12/58, 5 false T.
opportunities.success_metric: Pre-registered ADVISORY_USEFUL on both option orders over the 58 blind-agreed cases.
opportunities.falsifier: Under 60% exact match or more than three false T (KILL); or absence still read as refutation after the definitions spell out the absence rule (step 2 NOT_FIXED).
opportunities.simpler_alternative: A deterministic existence check decides U vs F whenever the artefact can be looked up; the model only ranks what remains.
opportunities.authority: Advisory only: a Jev value is one input to Demerzel's deterministic confidence ladder, never a verdict; C still escalates to a human.
opportunities.next_gate: Merge the correction https://github.com/GuitarAlchemist/Demerzel/pull/1128 (T/P is a recorded sufficiency judgement; existence predicates can be F); revisit only if a repository builds a model-on-evidence seam (gaia#159).
opportunities.result: Step 1 (Demerzel definitions, 120 calls, $0.0027 computed): 41/58 both orders, 0 false T, 7/10 absences read as F/D in both orders, 4/10 conflicts collapsed to F: INCONCLUSIVE. Step 2 (explicit U and C criteria, 120 calls, $0.0030): 46/58 and 44/58, 0 false T, conflicts 10/10, absences 4 and 5/10, but P fell into U 6/10: NOT_FIXED. Synthetic, English, agent-authored corpus; costs are reported usage times list price, not bills. Step 3 (U yields to leaning evidence, 120 calls, $0.0031): 48/58 both orders, P 9/10, C 10/10, but absences back to 7/10: NOT_FIXED. Real beliefs (8 at Demerzel 50d1163, 16 calls, $0.0007): no F/D/C, but two P answered T: FAIL; b02's file does not say what verification is missing, so its P is not readable from evidence (a first explanation blaming the confidence ladder was wrong: confidence measures the assignment, the ladder governs action). Gaia has no model-on-evidence route (gaia#159 filed); IX uses Jev on no hexavalent value.
